reviews.author: Jim “Iwasz” Iwaszkiewicz
reviews.text: Let's not forget the winter services thats offered. Here they are back up a little when the storms come in but no problem they will get you Oh yeah they take care of my trees also and no negative thoughts about Travis running with a business

reviews.author: Dina Brandt
reviews.text: I have had Cumberland Tree Service to my home twice in the past two months to take out several trees. The crew does an amazing job. They are prompt, thorough, resepctive of protecting the property, and clean up everything. Both times my property has been left good as new, minus the cut trees. My service included the stump grinding and removal of debris and logs too. I would recommend this company for tree removal.

reviews.author: Lisa Davis
reviews.text: We had Bill and his crew here to take down 6 trees, and they did a wonderful job! Everything was done just as agreed originally, with respect for our property, and excellent clean up. Highly recommend!
